note: What Meshy should fix in each cat 3D model, from the lore audit (data/research/exact-looks.json). action: retexture (colours/markings only, 10 credits), rebuild (shape or style wrong, about 36 credits) or ok. priority 1 = wrong at a glance, 2 = clear marking/eye/accessory errors, 3 = small drift. Run with scripts/meshy.mjs.

Soft-edged, blended honey-gold/amber tortie patches and fine brindling on only about 20% of the coat: a gold blaze on the forehead, gold on the cheeks, chest and legs, small gold flecks on the tail. No hard-edged geometric blocks, no pumpkin-orange camouflage, no tabby bands. Green-gold (yellow-green) eyes with black pupils, dark nose, dark inner ears. Short realistic fur texture. No clothing or accessories.
